title: Data residency
description: Pin each org's control-plane data to a region, or leave it unpinned. Superadmin only; every change is recorded in the audit ledger.

dialog.knownRegionHint: Choose a region from this deployment's configured registry.
dialog.fallbackRegionHint: No region registry is configured. This deployment is in the single-region/default posture; the server may reject a non-empty pin.
dialog.selectClearHint: Choose Clear pin (unpinned) to remove the pin. This does not move already-stored data — that is a separate migration.
dialog.title: Region for {{name}}
dialog.subtitle: Pin this org's data to a region, or clear the pin.
dialog.clearHint: Leave empty to clear the pin (unpinned). This does not move already-stored data — that is a separate migration.
dialog.implications: This sets where this org's data is promised to reside for new writes. It does not migrate data already stored elsewhere.
